section.title: Dangerous command floor
section.subtitle: A hard stop ahead of every permission mode and approval card: dangerous commands, the blacklist, unattended runs
field.chain.label: Where it sits in the chain
field.chain.text: order 5: ahead of the mode gate (10), the safety hooks (20) and approval (30). So when it says no, no permission mode can overrule it; when it says yes, anything the mode rejects is still rejected.
field.order.label: Evaluation order
field.order.text: Unverifiable structure → disaster floor → user deny list → dangerous mode (denied only when unattended) → command allowlist → hand over to the guards behind it.
field.allowPrefixes.label: Command allowlist (one per line, commas work too)
field.allowPrefixes.help: A match skips the approval card. Words are split on spaces and compared from the start, and `*` is only allowed at the end. Commands with pipes, semicolons, subshells, variables, redirects or quotes never use the allowlist.
field.denyGlobs.label: Command blacklist (one per line, globs)
field.denyGlobs.help: Rejected when it turns up in an argument word or a write target path, before full access applies. `*` matches any run of characters, `?` matches one.
field.maxCommandLength.label: Command length limit (characters)
field.maxCommandLength.help: Longer commands are rejected as “can't tell what this will run”. Range {min}–{max}.
field.unattended.label: Unattended
field.unattended.help: Turn this on for cron jobs and scripts where nobody clicks a card: ask-level commands and writes outside the workspace are refused, and no answer is expected. The desktop has no reliable interaction signal, so this can only be switched on by hand.
field.circuitBreakerEnabled.label: Trip after repeated denials
field.circuitBreakerThreshold.label: Trip threshold (denials in a row)
field.circuitBreakerThreshold.help: Only denials from the floor itself count; how approval rules in the end is invisible to it.
field.circuitBreakerCooldownMs.label: Trip cooldown (ms)
field.circuitBreakerCooldownMs.help: Judging resumes automatically after the cooldown; resuming does not loosen the rules, it only lets the model try a different approach.
field.allowCount.label: Allowlist entries
field.denyCount.label: Blacklist entries
field.problems.label: The config has problems, so everything is refused
field.problems.help: Fix the controls above (or edit the config file) and it recovers at once. When the floor cannot read its config it does not quietly let things through.
